tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Ensign green. Primary buttons, links, active step, focus ring, icon fills on tint backgrounds.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state for anything using brand.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected/active background — current step, active video, pressed chip.

tokens.name: brand-tint-soft
tokens.usage: Hover background for chips and list rows before they're active.

tokens.name: accent-gold
tokens.usage: Ensign gold. Reserved for identity marks only — the logo mark's inset shadow, the cover, print/brand materials. Never a UI action color.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on light surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text — descriptions, timestamps, helper copy, eyebrows.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, header, sidebar, composer, message bubbles.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover background for plain list rows (resource links).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default hairlines — panel dividers, card borders, header/footer rules.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Interactive control borders — buttons, inputs, disabled controls — for stronger contrast than the default hairline.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Background for positive status pills (system online).

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: Border for positive status pills and confirmation toasts.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Text on success-bg; confirmation messages.

tokens.name: success-icon
tokens.usage: The small status dot inside a positive status pill.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Background for caution accents (e.g. media/attachment markers).

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Text/icon on warning-bg.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Inline error text (e.g. wrong file type).

tokens.name: muted-strong
tokens.usage: Disabled control fill (e.g. Send button while empty).

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind a mobile drawer or modal.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Page/step headline — "Step 2 of 4 · Career Explorer Report".

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: In-content subheadings inside a message or card.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Primary reading size — chat text, descriptions. Never set body text below 17px; this audience reads on 1080p monitors and skews older.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Inline emphasis within body text, name labels ("You", "Career Explorer Coach").

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary UI text — button labels, step descriptions, nav item titles.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section labels in caps-adjacent tone — "YOUR FOUR STEPS", "WATCH", "RESOURCES".

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Button and pill text, status labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper text, hints, footer notes. This is the floor — nothing on the page goes smaller.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps inside a tight control.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between adjacent controls (chip row, header actions).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside a row (avatar to text, icon to label in a card).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Standard card padding on phones; gap between stacked cards in the feed.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on tablet+; vertical rhythm inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Minimum side gutter on desktop; breathing room around the composer.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Generous section spacing on wide layouts.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Outer page gutter ceiling on very wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small icon tiles, video-type badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav rows, the logo mark.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, message bubbles, the composer, video player, toast.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, suggested-question chips, round icon buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Assistant message cards, video player, mobile drawer surfaces.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: The composer when focused — replaces shadow-card, adds a brand-colored focus halo.

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: Toast notifications and other elements that float above the page.
